summary.content:
Today's selection covers 64 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 44 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: We’re feeling cynical about xAI’s big deal with Anthropic
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: JDownloader site hacked to replace installers with Python RAT malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 5 articles published in the last 24 hours
